text: Agile methodology is a modern way to manage projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a prioritized list of user stories describing what users need. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and solve problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to improve the product step by step, get feedback quickly, and adapt to changes without wasting time on long, detailed plans.
